LanguageData.RM_ColdStorage_SetpointDesc: Set the temperature this unit holds its contents at. Now: {0}.
LanguageData.RM_ColdStorage_Drifting: - not running, drifting toward the room temperature
LanguageData.RM_ColdStorage_StasisOffChilling: Stasis is switched off in Mod Settings: this unit chills instead.
LanguageData.RM_ColdStorage_StasisDown: {0}: field down, contents spoil as normal
LanguageData.RM_ColdStorage_StasisPartial: Partial field ({0} strength): contents spoil at {1} of the normal rate
LanguageData.RM_ColdStorage_SwitchedOff: Cold storage is switched off in Mod Settings: a plain shelf.
LanguageData.RM_ColdStorage_BreakSealDesc: Open these goods. Once opened they spoil as normal and cannot be resealed.
LanguageData.RM_ColdStorage_SettingsAppliesNow: Changes apply at once, to units and goods already on the map.
LanguageData.RM_ColdStorage_SettingChillDesc: Units hold their own temperature and the goods on them read it. Off: chill units are plain shelves.
LanguageData.RM_ColdStorage_SettingStasisDesc: Stasis fields stop spoiling and deterioration. Off: stasis units chill at -10°C instead. Sealed goods keep until opened either way.
LanguageData.RM_ColdStorage_SettingAgingDesc: Sealed goods that can age turn into their aged form after a while, with a small chance of ruin. Off: they stay as they are.
LanguageData.RM_ColdStorage_SettingInsulation: Insulation (how slowly an unpowered unit warms): x{0}
LanguageData.RM_ColdStorage_SettingFailure: Chance of ruin when aging: x{0}
LanguageData.RM_ColdStorage_SettingsMethodsNote: A method switched off hides its stations and recipes. Goods already made keep their properties.
LanguageData.RM_ColdStorage_SettingHopper: Units can feed a nutrient paste dispenser
LanguageData.RM_ColdStorage_SettingHopperDesc: Units built to do so act as hoppers when placed against a dispenser.
